Maketing Lead Job at TalentForge Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        TalentForge Solutions Limited is a full-service Human Resources consulting firm with active recruitment and outsourcing operations across various cities and locations. Our client in the financialindustry is seeking to employ a qualified and results-driven Marketing Leadto join their team.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Maketing Lead
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Location: Port Harcourt
Work Mode: Onsite | Monday - Friday
Industry: Finance

About the Role
     

            
    




	We’re looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager to lead brand growth, customer acquisition, and market presence in Port Harcourt. You’ll work closely with sales and leadership to build campaigns that actually convert.


Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Execution:


	Develop quarterly and monthly marketing plans aligned to business goals
	Execute integrated campaigns across digital, radio, OOH, events, and community outreach
	Own the marketing budget and ensure efficient spend with measurable ROI


Lead Generation & Sales Support:


	Design and run campaigns to generate qualified leads for the sales team
	Set up and manage lead tracking, follow-up systems, and conversion reporting.


Requirements


	BSc/HND in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related fields
	2-4 years of proven marketing experience
	Demonstrated success with lead gen campaigns and brand campaigns
	Proficient in Canva, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, MS Office
	Strong copywriting and public speaking skills
	Must reside in Port Harcourt and work onsite Mon-Fri.


Salary
N250,000/month + commission. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.     

    

        Click here to Apply

Executive Assistant Job at TalentForge Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        TalentForge Solutions Limited - Our client in the Technology industry is recruiting qualified and results-driven candidates to fill the position below:

Job Position: Executive Assistant

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

About the Role


	We are looking for a proactive, organized, and discreet Executive Assistant to support senior leader
	You’ll be the right hand for managing schedules, communications, and operations to ensure everything runs smoothly.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage executive calendar, schedule meetings, book travel, and handle logistics
	Draft emails, memos, reports, and correspondence on behalf of leadership
	Prepare documents, presentations, and meeting minutes. Maintain files and records
	Coordinate between departments, clients, and external stakeholders
	Handle confidential information, track action items, and follow up to ensure deadlines are met
	Anticipate needs, troubleshoot issues, and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Requirements


	HND / BSc in Business Administration, Office Management, or related field
	3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or in a similar administrative role
	Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and calendar management tools
	High level of discretion, professionalism, and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Executive Assistant" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Internal Control Officer (Audit) Job at Brands Optimal Limited




        
    

        
        Brands Optimal Limited is one of Africa’s leading experiential marketing agencies, which optimizes value for clients through the use of strategic, reliable, and measurable methods in consumer engagement, loyalty seeding, and sales generation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Internal Control Officer (Audit)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Experiential Marketing

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Internal Control & Field Assurance Officer will serve as the agency’s primary line of defense against fraud, budget inflation, and campaign operational failures.
	You will enforce strict compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs) during agency campaigns and identify financial leakage points across vendor management and project execution.


Key Responsibilities


	Forensic Auditing: Investigate budget overruns, vendor invoices, and project float retirement discrepancies.
	Live Spot Checks: Conduct unannounced field visits to activation sites to verify promoter compliance and asset deployment.
	Process Risk Mapping: Evaluate standard workflows across all departments to patch internal control vulnerabilities.
	Post-Activation Reconciliation: Audit and reconcile post-event project retirements, ensuring all receipts, field logs, and vendor invoices are genuine and accurate.
	Asset Tracking: Track the movement and storage of brand assets, rigs, electronics, and point-of-sale materials (POSMs) in the warehouse.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printings, and merchandise.
	Corrective Action Planning: Work with heads of departments to correct audit exceptions and build stronger financial guardrails.
	Vendor Price Vetting: Periodically audit procurement processes and benchmark vendor quotes against market prices for setups, fabrications, printings, and merchandise.
	Exception Reporting: Maintain a weekly audit exception tracker and report all control breaches, financial errors, or suspicious activities directly to Management


Requirements & Qualifications


	Education: B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related business discipline.
	Experience: 3 to 4 years of proven experience in Internal Control, Internal Audit, or Compliance (experience in an agency, media firm, or FMCG environment is highly valued).
	Professional Stage: ACA / ACCA qualified, or currently in the final professional stages.
	Technical Skills: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (formulas, pivot tables) and accounting software/ERP systems.


Method of Application

	We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Marketing Officer to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth through outdoor and on-ground marketing activities.

	This role is strictly field-based and requires someone who is confident, persuasive, and comfortable engaging clients face-to-face.

	Conduct outdoor marketing and sales visits to corporate offices, schools, event planners, and organizations.
	Identify and generate leads for bulk orders (uniforms, corporate wear, event outfits, etc.).
	Pitch products and services directly to potential clients and decision-makers.
	Distribute company profiles, samples, and promotional materials during visits.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients.
	Follow up on leads and convert them into confirmed sales.
	Negotiate pricing and close deals in line with company targets.
	Provide regular feedback on market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
	Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions.

	Proven experience in outdoor/physical sales and client acquisition
	Strong communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills
	Confident in approaching and engaging clients physically (door-to-door, office visits, etc.)
	Good knowledge of the Abuja market (Wuse, Maitama, Garki, and surrounding areas)
	Ability to work independently and meet sales targets
	Energetic, proactive, and result-oriented

	Field Sales &amp; Prospecting
	Client Engagement &amp; Relationship Management
	Negotiation &amp; Closing

Marketing Officer (Garment Production) Job at Bevany Resources




        
    

        
        Bevany Resources is a recruitment and human talent support firm dedicated to connecting qualified candidates with forward-thinking employers. We specialise in talent acquisition, candidate screening, interview coordination, and providing recruitment support services to organisations across various industries. Our mission is to ensure businesses build strong teams while helping  job seekers find meaningful career opportunities.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Officer (Garment Production)
     

            
    



Job Location: Wuse 2, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Fashion / Garment Production

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Marketing Officer to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth through outdoor and on-ground marketing activities.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for physically visiting businesses, corporate offices, schools, and organizations to promote the company’s products and services, secure bulk orders, and build long-term client relationships.
	This role is strictly field-based and requires someone who is confident, persuasive, and comfortable engaging clients face-to-face.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct outdoor marketing and sales visits to corporate offices, schools, event planners, and organizations.
	Identify and generate leads for bulk orders (uniforms, corporate wear, event outfits, etc.).
	Pitch products and services directly to potential clients and decision-makers.
	Distribute company profiles, samples, and promotional materials during visits.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients.
	Follow up on leads and convert them into confirmed sales.
	Negotiate pricing and close deals in line with company targets.
	Provide regular feedback on market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
	Maintain accurate records of visits, leads, and conversions.
	Represent the brand professionally at all times during client interactions.


Requirements


	2–4 years of experience in Sales, Marketing, or Business Development
	Proven experience in outdoor/physical sales and client acquisition
	Strong communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills
	Confident in approaching and engaging clients physically (door-to-door, office visits, etc.)
	Good knowledge of the Abuja market (Wuse, Maitama, Garki, and surrounding areas)
	Ability to work independently and meet sales targets
	Energetic, proactive, and result-oriented


Key Competencies:


	Field Sales & Prospecting
	Client Engagement & Relationship Management
	Negotiation & Closing
	Market Awareness
	Resilience & Target-Driven Execution.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 / month based on experience.
